children: Prediction market platform Kalshi won a key ruling from the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, allowing it to continue operating its event contracts in Ohio and Tennessee. According to ChainCatcher, the decision concerns a dispute between Kalshi and state regulators over whether the contracts can remain available in those states. The court ruled that Kalshi may keep offering the event contracts while the case proceeds.

title: Kalshi Wins Sixth Circuit Ruling to Continue Event Contracts in Ohio and Tennessee
